sections.title: Validation
sections.text: Query, command, idempotent replay, cursor continuation and both error media types pass via REST; matching exposed operation passes via MCP; parity receipt binds snapshot digests. HTTP success→record/field revocation→MCP replay denies/prunes with one effect. UUIDv7, UUID, ULID and integer ResourceIds round-trip through both clients. Stale digest, unexpected field and GraphQL artifact fail.
